profile.name: Timepix4 像素探测器
profile.description: 用于实验中 Timepix4 像素探测器的控制与数据采集，可加载配置、设置像素阈值/掩膜/测试参数、管理以太网数据过滤，并启动、停止和记录探测数据。
profile.description_en: Controls a Timepix4 pixel detector for laboratory data acquisition, including loading configuration, setting pixel threshold/mask/test parameters, managing Ethernet data filtering, and starting, stopping, and recording detector data.
